## **About Beta Bionics**

Beta Bionics, Inc. is a medical technology company dedicated to bringing innovative Type 1 diabetes management solutions to the many, not the few. We are committed to bringing better access to better solutions – and a better life for those living with diabetes – with the world’s first bionic pancreas called the iLet. The iLet Bionic Pancreas is the first and only insulin delivery system that does not require carb counting\*, bolusing, correction factors, or pre-set basal rates. The only number needed to get started with the iLet Bionic Pancreas is a user’s weight – the iLet does the rest. The iLet lets users “Go Bionic” with their diabetes management.

\*User must be carb aware.

Successful candidates will be working with highly experienced colleagues, who are amongst the best in their fields. We have a mission-driven, passionate, and collaborative culture where you will have a high degree of empowerment and opportunity to make a significant impact.

**Location:** **Remote (United States), Pacific Time Zone strongly preferred. San Diego, CA preferred for local candidates.**

**Position Summary**

Beta Bionics is seeking a strategic, hands-on marketer to lead consumer marketing and digital engagement across the consumer journey. The Senior Manager, Consumer & Digital Marketing will develop consumer marketing strategies, positioning, messaging, integrated campaigns, and digital experiences that increase awareness, drive patient acquisition, support product adoption, and strengthen consumer engagement.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who thrives on building new capabilities while remaining hands-on in the work. The ideal candidate enjoys balancing strategy with execution and is equally comfortable in developing messaging, launching new products, managing agencies, building integrated campaigns, directing creative, and analyzing performance.

This role partners closely with Social Media & Influencer Marketing, HCP Marketing, Product, Clinical, Sales, Customer Care, Legal, Regulatory, and agency partners to ensure every touchpoint delivers a consistent, compelling brand experience. As Beta Bionics continues to grow, this position offers the opportunity to expand leadership and broaden its impact across the marketing organization.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

\[Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Qualified candidates who need a reasonable accommodation with the application process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position should notify the company’s HR contact\]

**Consumer Marketin** **g Strategy & Campaign Development**

- Develop consumer marketing strategies, positioning, messaging, and integrated campaigns that drive awareness, patient acquisition, product adoption, and consumer engagement.
- Lead the consumer launch plans for new products, features, and innovations in partnership with Product, Clinical, Commercial, and HCP Marketing.
- Translate customer insights, market trends, and business priorities into marketing initiatives that strengthen the Beta Bionics brand and support commercial objectives.

**Digital Marketing and Paid Media**

- Lead the strategy and optimization of the Beta Bionics website, digital content, videos, and consumer experience to improve awareness, education, and conversion.
- Own paid media strategy and execution across programmatic, paid search, SEO/AEO, video, paid social, and emerging digital channels while managing agency partners.
- Develop email marketing and digital customer engagement programs and partner with the Social Media & Influencer Marketing Manager to deliver integrated campaigns across paid, owned, earned, and social channels.

**Consumer Engagement and Lifecycle Marketing**

- Develop and execute customer email marketing strategies that support acquisition, onboarding, retention, and advocacy.
- Build customer journeys that deliver the right message at the right time across digital channels.
- Partner with Customer Care and Clinical teams to improve customer engagement throughout the lifecycle.

**Patient Education**

- Lead the development of patient-facing educational materials, including brochures, videos, digital content, and other resources that support awareness, confidence, and successful product adoption.
- Partner closely with HCP Marketing to develop educational resources that empower healthcare professionals to educate, train, and care for their patients using Beta Bionics products.
- Ensure patient education materials are engaging, accurate, compliant, and aligned with the brand and regulatory requirements.

**Performance, Reporting & Optimization**

- Define KPIs across consumer marketing initiatives, paid media, website performance, email marketing, and digital campaigns.
- Measure campaign performance, customer behavior, and marketing effectiveness to identify opportunities for optimization.
- Continuously improve messaging, creative, customer journeys, and media investments while holding agency partners accountable for delivering measurable business results.

**Qualifications**

**Required Education and Experience**

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field.
- 7+ years of experience in consumer marketing, digital marketing, brand marketing, product marketing, or integrated marketing.
- Demonstrated success developing positioning, messaging, and integrated marketing campaigns, preferably in competitive industries.
- Experience launching new products and bringing innovations to market.
- Experience managing agencies and partnering with internal creative teams.
- Strong analytical skills with experience developing KPIs and measuring marketing effectiveness.
- Comfortable leveraging AI-powered tools to improve marketing productivity, content development, and campaign optimization.

**Preferred Experience**

- Experience in diabetes technology, healthcare, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, life sciences, or digital health.
- Demonstrated team leadership of cross-functional teams and/or previous people leadership.
- Knowledge of HIPAA, FDA promotional guidelines, privacy regulations, and healthcare marketing compliance.
- Prior Consumer products experience is a plus.

**Travel Requirements**

- Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.
- Flexibility to work evenings or weekends if necessary to complete urgent priorities or attend conferences and events.

**Salary & Benefits**

- $140,000-210,000 USD
- Our comprehensive benefits package includes:
  - Competitive base, bonus, plus equity
  - Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  - Employer-paid life, disability, and EAP coverage
  - 401(k) Plan with company match
  - Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  - Open PTO Policy, 10 Paid holidays

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

It is the policy of Beta Bionics to provide equal employment opportunity to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Beta Bionics will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

About Beta Bionics

Beta Bionics, Inc. is a medical technology company dedicated to bringing innovative Type 1 diabetes management solutions to the many, not the few. We are committed to bringing better access to better solutions – and a better life for those living with diabetes – with the world’s first bionic pancreas called the iLet. The iLet Bionic Pancreas is the first and only insulin delivery system that does not require carb counting*, bolusing, correction factors, or pre-set basal rates. The only number needed to get started with the iLet Bionic Pancreas is a user’s weight – the iLet does the rest. The iLet lets users “Go Bionic” with their diabetes management.

*User must be carb aware.

Successful candidates will be working with highly experienced colleagues, who are amongst the best in their fields. We have a mission-driven, passionate, and collaborative culture where you will have a high degree of empowerment and opportunity to make a significant impact.

Location: Remote (United States), Pacific Time Zone strongly preferred. San Diego, CA preferred for local candidates.


Position Summary

Beta Bionics is seeking a strategic, hands-on marketer to lead consumer marketing and digital engagement across the consumer journey. The Senior Manager, Consumer & Digital Marketing will develop consumer marketing strategies, positioning, messaging, integrated campaigns, and digital experiences that increase awareness, drive patient acquisition, support product adoption, and strengthen consumer engagement.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who thrives on building new capabilities while remaining hands-on in the work. The ideal candidate enjoys balancing strategy with execution and is equally comfortable in developing messaging, launching new products, managing agencies, building integrated campaigns, directing creative, and analyzing performance.

This role partners closely with Social Media & Influencer Marketing, HCP Marketing, Product, Clinical, Sales, Customer Care, Legal, Regulatory, and agency partners to ensure every touchpoint delivers a consistent, compelling brand experience. As Beta Bionics continues to grow, this position offers the opportunity to expand leadership and broaden its impact across the marketing organization.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

[Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Qualified candidates who need a reasonable accommodation with the application process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position should notify the company’s HR contact]

Consumer Marketing Strategy & Campaign Development

  • Develop consumer marketing strategies, positioning, messaging, and integrated campaigns that drive awareness, patient acquisition, product adoption, and consumer engagement.
  • Lead the consumer launch plans for new products, features, and innovations in partnership with Product, Clinical, Commercial, and HCP Marketing.
  • Translate customer insights, market trends, and business priorities into marketing initiatives that strengthen the Beta Bionics brand and support commercial objectives.

Digital Marketing and Paid Media

  • Lead the strategy and optimization of the Beta Bionics website, digital content, videos, and consumer experience to improve awareness, education, and conversion.
  • Own paid media strategy and execution across programmatic, paid search, SEO/AEO, video, paid social, and emerging digital channels while managing agency partners.
  • Develop email marketing and digital customer engagement programs and partner with the Social Media & Influencer Marketing Manager to deliver integrated campaigns across paid, owned, earned, and social channels.

Consumer Engagement and Lifecycle Marketing

  • Develop and execute customer email marketing strategies that support acquisition, onboarding, retention, and advocacy.
  • Build customer journeys that deliver the right message at the right time across digital channels.
  • Partner with Customer Care and Clinical teams to improve customer engagement throughout the lifecycle.

Patient Education

  • Lead the development of patient-facing educational materials, including brochures, videos, digital content, and other resources that support awareness, confidence, and successful product adoption.
  • Partner closely with HCP Marketing to develop educational resources that empower healthcare professionals to educate, train, and care for their patients using Beta Bionics products.
  • Ensure patient education materials are engaging, accurate, compliant, and aligned with the brand and regulatory requirements.

Performance, Reporting & Optimization

  • Define KPIs across consumer marketing initiatives, paid media, website performance, email marketing, and digital campaigns.
  • Measure campaign performance, customer behavior, and marketing effectiveness to identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Continuously improve messaging, creative, customer journeys, and media investments while holding agency partners accountable for delivering measurable business results.

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in consumer marketing, digital marketing, brand marketing, product marketing, or integrated marketing.
  • Demonstrated success developing positioning, messaging, and integrated marketing campaigns, preferably in competitive industries.
  • Experience launching new products and bringing innovations to market.
  • Experience managing agencies and partnering with internal creative teams.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience developing KPIs and measuring marketing effectiveness.
  • Comfortable leveraging AI-powered tools to improve marketing productivity, content development, and campaign optimization.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in diabetes technology, healthcare, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, life sciences, or digital health.
  • Demonstrated team leadership of cross-functional teams and/or previous people leadership.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA, FDA promotional guidelines, privacy regulations, and healthcare marketing compliance.
  • Prior Consumer products experience is a plus.

Travel Requirements

  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.
  • Flexibility to work evenings or weekends if necessary to complete urgent priorities or attend conferences and events.

Salary & Benefits

  • $140,000-210,000 USD
  • Our comprehensive benefits package includes:
    • Competitive base, bonus, plus equity
    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
    • Employer-paid life, disability, and EAP coverage
    • 401(k) Plan with company match
    • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
    • Open PTO Policy, 10 Paid holidays

Equal Employment Opportunity

It is the policy of Beta Bionics to provide equal employment opportunity to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Beta Bionics will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.
